entities.name: SMF
entities.description: Session Management Function that may include the IP header compression configuration IE under certain conditions.

entities.name: IP header compression configuration IE
entities.description: Information element containing IP header compression configuration parameters.

entities.name: Network accepts IP PDU session type
entities.description: Condition where the network accepts an IP PDU session type.

entities.name: Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization is selected
entities.description: Condition where control plane CIoT 5GS optimization is selected.

entities.name: UE provided IP header compression configuration IE
entities.description: Condition where the UE provided the IP header compression configuration IE in the PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request establishment of a PDU session.

relations.description: SMF may include the IP header compression configuration IE when conditions are met.
SMF includes the IE only if network accepts IP PDU session type.
SMF includes the IE only if control plane CIoT 5GS optimization is selected.
SMF includes the IE only if UE provided the IE in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message may contain the IP header compression configuration IE.
